paper: GuruAgents: Emulating Wise Investors with Prompt-Guided LLM Agents
headline_strategy: Evaluate the paper-highlighted Warren Buffett GuruAgent sleeve by executing the official prompt's disclosed deterministic quality-value score and score-proportional long-only portfolio on the common monthly U.S./JKP universe.
headline_selection_basis: The abstract identifies the Buffett GuruAgent as the paper's highest-performing agent (reported 42.2% CAGR). This selection uses the paper's headline claim and source formula before inspecting the new JKP result; it is not selected from prior JKP proxy performance.

source_rule.scaling: min-max to [0,1], with 0.50 when a metric has no spread
source_rule.per_ticker_missing_rule: drop missing components and renormalize remaining weights proportionally
source_rule.portfolio: include all eligible tickers with weights proportional to score

jkp_input_mapping.fidelity: balance-sheet identity adapter for total liabilities divided by book equity
algebraic inverse of direct JKP book-to-market
algebraic inverse of direct JKP earnings-to-price
ratio reconstruction of the source NOPAT-to-invested-capital definition
source maintenance-capex convention reconstructed on a market-equity denominator

intentionally_missing_source_metrics.reason: JKP's available quarterly-margin volatility uses a different estimation window from the source's last-four-quarter standard deviation.
JKP payout and share-change fields do not exactly reproduce the source's first-versus-last share count over its last four observations.

quality_missing_renormalization: Preserve the source's +0.38 positive and -0.06 negative QualityPlus budgets separately. Renormalize the available positive ROCE/CashConversion weights to +0.38; retain the available CapExIntensity weight at -0.06.

common_task_adaptations.universe: formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. stocks instead of a static NASDAQ-100 file
common_task_adaptations.accounting_availability: JKP point-in-time conventions instead of source quarter-label next-day availability
common_task_adaptations.scorer: deterministic execution of the disclosed formula instead of GPT-4o arithmetic/table generation
common_task_adaptations.weights: continuous score-proportional weights instead of integer percentages, avoiding a 100-percentage-point rounding collapse in a 1,000-stock universe

excluded_source_behaviors: LLM persona prose and one-sentence rationales
prior_outcome_boundary: Prior GuruAgents workbook, prompt replay and narrative-proxy outcomes are known. The Buffett sleeve and exact disclosed source formula were selected from the paper/source before this new JKP run; results are exploratory, not a pristine holdout.
